label_basis: Original source filenames explicitly identify CV at 10-09 M or 10-10 M; BGethanol files are CV-free substrate/ethanol backgrounds, assigned 0.
quant_unit_basis: Author filename nominal molarity. Final substrate adsorption concentration or any mixing dilution has not been independently re-established.
processing_level: Author-provided nobase TXT spectral exports. No baseline correction or normalization is applied by importer; prior acquisition-software correction history is not independently established.
coordinate_mapping: First row after the empty first cell is the actual Raman-shift axis. First column of subsequent rows is the map coordinate, retained in manifest rather than misused as RamanShift.
recommended_split: Keep each map in one split; do not split its 201 positions randomly. New-preparation generalization requires more independently prepared standards.
limitations: Only two nonzero nominal concentrations plus blanks are available. This is a pilot/background challenge, not a broad concentration calibration curve.
Independent preparation and substrate-batch identities beyond source filenames remain unknown.

The original dataset was cited for background-removal evaluation. A quantitative task is derived from explicit filename labels; it is not a reproduction of the paper's prepared-mixture quantification experiment.

CV must not be silently expanded to crystal violet without explicit chemical identity evidence. The task can be used with identity/structure marked unknown; structure-conditioned analyses must mask it.
